text:
maya: Heads-up: users are reappearing after SCIM deprovision. Noticing same accounts re-provisioned ~10m after deprov.
lee: Can you paste an example user + timestamps?
maya: user: jdoe@acme.com, deprov at 2026-03-19T13:02:07Z, reprovision seen ~2026-03-19T13:12:15Z. Logs show we did apply tombstone but then a provision_batch created the account again.
--- log snippet ---
[2026-03-19T13:02:07Z] scim-provisioner INFO apply_tombstone user=jdoe external_id=acme|jdoe tx=tx123
[2026-03-19T13:02:07Z] scim-sync INFO tombstone_marked user=jdoe head=tx123
[2026-03-19T13:12:15Z] scim-sync INFO provision_batch user=jdoe source=idp-prod tx=tx130 request_id=req-9a3b
--- end snippet ---
sam: That looks like a tombstone propagation / ordering problem. If the tombstone is only in the local store but the re-provision event arrives via the idp stream it won't be deduped.
lee: We moved provisioning events into partitioned queues last quarter; ordering guarantees are per-partition. Could be cross-partition replay. syncbot: can you show last sync window for idp-prod?
syncbot: last_full_sync idp-prod started=2026-03-19T13:00:00Z finished=2026-03-19T13:15:00Z batches=420 failures=2
maya: So tombstone applied at 13:02 but the idp replay had a provision event processed at 13:12 in a later batch. Tombstone TTL might have expired or we didn't consult tombstone store in provisioner.
jordan: We rely on external_id mapping + tombstone ttl. What's current TTL?
lee: Current config: scim.tombstone.ttl_seconds = 600 (10m). That matches the ~10m window. If the replay is delayed > TTL we allow re-create.
maya: Short-term: increase TTL. Medium: make provisioner check tombstone index at provision time and consult last_request_id per external_id.
sam: Also we can use idempotency key present in idp event (request_id). If we store last seen request_id per external_id we can drop replayed events.
maya: I'll open a PR to bump TTL to 3600 (1h) and add a metric scim.tombstone.reprovision counter. Patch will be minimal to reduce blast radius.
lee: Can we also add a guard: if deprov happened <1h ago, reject create and surface to CS for reconciliation?
maya: Yes — config toggle patch example: 
```yaml
# proposed change
scim:
  tombstone:
    ttl_seconds: 3600  # was 600
  enforcement:
    block_recreate_window_seconds: 3600
```
lee: Good. Who's taking incident/CS comms? CS reported 2 impacted customers so far.
maya: Filed INV-2026-113 on PagerDuty, assigning to eng-security. I'll post the PR and a short roll-forward plan.
syncbot: deploy-bot: deployment/rbx-provisioner @ production started by maya at 2026-03-19T14:05:00Z
opsbot: canary: 2 nodes ok, traffic shifted at 2026-03-19T14:09:00Z
jordan: :thumbsup: After deploy let's monitor scim.tombstone.reprovision and scim.provision.count for 24h.
sam: Also add an alert if reprovision rate > baseline*3 in 1h.
maya: Will do. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbx-provisioner/pull/342 (added in thread). Will follow up with postmortem once we validate.
lee: Thanks everyone.
opsbot: note: CS ticket #CS-1849 created for impacted customers.
